title: Crocheting Stitches
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Agriculture; not yet checked by a CBC Agriculture teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use a 5 mm hook and thick cotton or reused yarn; make a short chain and a small square of single crochet before a mat or wiper.

skills.key_step: The child names the basic crochet stitches (chain, slip stitch, single crochet, double crochet), the tool (one hook) and household articles made (mats, rugs, wipers, bags), and tells crochet from knitting.

floor.prerequisite: Knows how stitches differ by look.
floor.question: Which stitch has no gaps?

representations: a hook and samples of each stitch
steps: One hook: crochet. Two needles: knitting.
Single is short; double is taller.

board.do: Draw a hook and two needles.

misconceptions.repair: Show the hook and two needles.

misconceptions.ask: Which stitch is the base of a crocheted piece?
misconceptions.repair: Start a piece with a chain.
Crochet a row of each and compare.

misconceptions.ask: Which household article can be crocheted?
misconceptions.repair: Show a crocheted mat and a kitchen wiper.

checks.question: What tool is used for crocheting?
Which is taller: single or double crochet?

skills.key_step: The child says how a crocheted article is made: slip knot, chain to length, turning chain, rows of single or double crochet with even tension, fasten off, weave in the end.

floor.question: What is the first stitch made?

steps: Make a slip knot and a chain.
Work rows of single or double crochet.

board.do: Draw a square whose sides slope inwards.

misconceptions.ask: Why is a turning chain made at the end of each row?
misconceptions.repair: Show a square with turning chains and one without; compare the edges.

misconceptions.ask: Why count the stitches in the first chain?
misconceptions.repair: Compare two wipers: one counted, one not; measure the widths of the rows.

misconceptions.ask: What happens if crochet stitches are pulled too tight?
misconceptions.repair: Try to push the hook into a very tight chain.

listen_for: Cut the yarn and leave it
misconceptions.repair: Pull a finished piece cut without fastening: it unravels.

checks.question: What is done at the end of each row?
How is the last stitch finished?
checks.answer: pull the yarn through the last loop and weave it in
